headline: The producer of Fleabag and Baby Reindeer's tip for finding a hit? Don't look for one
context: Theatre producer Francesca Moody has a remarkable record of spotting shows that go on to have wide success. At the Edinburgh Fringe festival, she told NPR about what she looks for in a performance.
